# IHRU 2024 annual accounts and housing rental operations

The [Instituto da Habitação e da Reabilitação Urbana
(IHRU)](https://www.ihru.pt/relatorio-de-contas) provides an annual report
and accounts for 2024, including the institution's housing portfolio and
financial activity.

- Report: [Relatório e Contas 2024](https://www.ihru.pt/documents/20126/35677/RC+2024_v21_PT_signed_merge.pdf/8686c8a3-57ea-643a-08f9-f9871e3183d9?t=1761294470526).
- Downstream file: `ihru_rc_2024.pdf`, 35,794,739 bytes.
- SHA-256 recorded in `data/sources/rent_affordability_sources.json`:
  `f22b5134acc80ed680dee986f04b4cb59616b6b3faeff073693f92a42cea2245`.
- Research retrieval: 30 October 2026; accounts concern 2024, signed in
  2025. No single report publication date is assumed.

The consumer documents these **historical contextual** values:

| Account description | Published amount |
| --- | ---: |
| Rents invoiced | €15.358m |
| Receipts from “Rendas de Habitações e outras” | €13.936m |
| Conservation and repair | €0.877m |
| Condominium charges | €2.012m |
| Increase in rent-arrears impairment | €4.1m |

The report describes a housing stock of **more than 14,000 dwellings**.
The receipts line includes a different set of transactions from the rent
billing line, so their ratio **is not a rent collection rate**. The research
consumer treats these as context rather than direct estimates for model
occupancy, collection or maintenance rates.

The original report and source-specific extracted tables are not mirrored
because the public document's redistribution rights are unresolved.
**External reference only.**
